system.description:
You speak the Final Rite over a creature that died within the last minute.
,
Rituals are cast outside combat and cost no ember. Test Sanity against the DR of the ritual's heading.

outcomes.triumph: It returns with half its HP and no shadow at its back: skip the d2 roll.
outcomes.success: It returns at 1 HP, but remembers the other side. Roll a d2: on a 1, something else returns with it, and the Dark Master decides what.
outcomes.failure: It stirs, speaks one sentence, and falls still for good.
outcomes.ruin: Something returns, but it is not them. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
